spell.chronomancy.accelerated_zone.guide: Cube with side 5 (+0.8/lvl). Enemies inside: +40% tempo and +40% damage taken (+5%/lvl), 8 s (+1 s/lvl). Entering or leaving: damage equal to 15% of the haste.
jei.chronomancy.spell.accelerated_zone: The opposite of the Time Dilation Field: throw the orb and a cube of rushing time unfolds where it lands. Enemies and projectiles inside are 40% faster (+5% per level, grows with spell power), but they also take that much more damage. An enemy that enters or leaves the zone takes damage equal to 15% of its haste; on the way out that damage is amplified by the zone. Sneak-cast for a smaller zone that follows you. If a zone and a Time Dilation Field touch, even with their edges, both collapse into a time paradox: a blast of time with a radius equal to the sum of their radii, dealing damage equal to the sum of the slow and haste percentages (40% + 40% = 80). The blast spares no one - not enemies, not allies, not you. It breaks no blocks, and survivors are left under Paradox - their time lurches between rushing and dragging. The stronger the blast, the longer it lasts: a quarter of the damage in seconds (80 damage - 20 s, 160 - 40 s). Chronomal creatures are not affected by it.
spell.chronomancy.accelerated_zone.parad: Zone touching a Time Dilation Field, even with an edge: time paradox (hurts everyone, you included)
spell.chronomancy.accelerated_zone.sneak: Sneak-cast: a smaller zone follows you
death.attack.chronomancy.accelerated_zon: %1$s could not take the time shear at the edge of %2$s's zone
death.attack.chronomancy.time_paradox: %1$s was torn apart by a time paradox thanks to %2$s
effect.chronomancy.paradox.description: Time runs out of step: you lurch between rushing ahead and dragging. Time needles build up on you twice as fast.
effect.chronomancy.sands_of_time.descrip: Sand of time: every layer makes you 20% slower.
spell.chronomancy.sands_of_time.guide: Cone, 5 s. Each second the target: −20% tempo, −20% damage from the sand. Stasis for 2 s at the end.
jei.chronomancy.spell.sands_of_time: A stream of the sand of time that must be held on a target for five seconds. With every second under the stream the target sinks deeper: its time runs 20% slower, but the sand also wounds it 20% less - 8, 6.4, 4.8, 3.2 and 1.6 damage per second at level one. The deeper the target sinks, the more it turns to copper. Whoever stands in the sand for the whole cast freezes in stasis for 2 seconds. Spell power raises the starting damage only; the slowing and the stasis do not depend on it. Turn the stream away for a second and a half and the sand falls off. The sand does not fall off in stasis: the target comes out still four layers deep.
death.attack.chronomancy.sands_of_time: %1$s was buried in the sands of time by %2$s
spell.chronomancy.time_piercing_needle.g: Fires after 1 s. Damage ×1.45 per needle. Collapses after 4 s.
jei.chronomancy.spell.time_piercing_need: A skill-shot. At cast a world rune locks your position and aim; one second later it fires a needle along that frozen trajectory - turning or moving afterwards does not change it, so a watchful target can dodge. The rune telegraphs the shot with a short directional indicator. Every hit multiplies your own charge on a target: one needle is 7.5 damage, each further one 1.45 times more. With every needle the target glitches through time harder, and your charge burns above it as a Roman numeral that only you can see. Four seconds without another hit collapse the charge. Spell power is applied once; chain limits and power are fixed at the first hit. On targets under Paradox or inside an Accelerated Zone the charge builds twice as fast.
Its pages still hold the wet ink of tomorrow.

Continuous spells are released |5×| faster, at |full| damage
Such a cast costs |double| the mana
item.chronomancy.grain_of_time.lore: A speck of time, shaken out of a broken clock.
item.chronomancy.time_rune.lore: The mark masters leave on a moment made to stand still.
item.chronomancy.chronomancy_upgrade_orb: A whole hour, wound into a sphere.
item.chronomancy.geminated_ring.effect: Its imprinted spell casts |twice| for |triple| mana
spell.chronomancy.temporal_stasis_beam.g: Stasis 3 s (+1 s/lvl, +0.5 s per 10% power).
jei.chronomancy.spell.temporal_stasis_be: Fires a beam of yellow time energy. On hit, freezes the target in place for 3 seconds. Every further stasis on the same target is 20% shorter; the count resets after a minute.
spell.chronomancy.temporal_stasis_beam.s: Time is stopped - the beam cannot reach its target

death.attack.chronomancy.backtrack: %1$s couldn't outrun their own past - %2$s caught up with them there
death.attack.chronomancy.chrono_double: %1$s was killed twice: first by %2$s, then by the echo
death.attack.chronomancy.temporal_stasis: %1$s was frozen in time - and when it started again, it was already too late
%1$s was turned inside out by time, courtesy of %2$s

school.chronomancy.chronomancy_desc: The magic of time and the sands of eternity.
jei.chronomancy.spell.time_dilation_fiel: Deploys a sphere of warped time. Everything inside - mobs, projectiles, even the weather - runs in slow motion, though it never fully freezes. Throw the orb to anchor the field where it lands, or sneak-cast a smaller field that follows you.
spell.chronomancy.time_dilation_field.th: Thrown orb: the field forms where it lands
spell.chronomancy.time_dilation_field.sn: Sneak-cast: a smaller field follows you
spell.chronomancy.rewind.guide: Rewinds 3 s (+1 s/lvl, up to 5 s).
jei.chronomancy.spell.rewind: Rolls your own state back to a few seconds ago. Your body is rewound in reverse along the path you just travelled, restoring recent health, hunger, air and equipment durability - but never items, XP, mana or spell cooldowns.
spell.chronomancy.rewind.restores: Restores recent Health / Hunger / Air / Durability
spell.chronomancy.rewind.excludes: Does NOT restore items, XP, mana or cooldowns
spell.chronomancy.backtrack.guide: Pulls the target 1 s back (+0.5 s/lvl, up to 4 s), hit after 1 s; +1.5 damage per block travelled.
jei.chronomancy.spell.backtrack: Fires a quick copper-gold temporal bolt. On hit the target is ripped back to where it stood a second ago - position only, never health - and exactly one second later the spell's damage catches up. Every hit carries its own delayed strike. The further the target travelled during the rewound seconds, the harder the hit: each block of path adds 1.5 more damage (scales with Chronomancy spell power). Teleports do not count as travel.
spell.chronomancy.the_world_stop.guide: Time stops for 6 s (+0.2 s per 10% power).
jei.chronomancy.spell.the_world_stop: The Legendary apex of Chronomancy. Time itself halts for six seconds: every creature, projectile, flame and clock in the world freezes mid-breath. Only the caster may act - yet even their own body is suspended outside time: health and mana do not recover on their own, only instant health and instant mana potions help. When the world resumes, everything held in the stopped moment plays out at once.
spell.chronomancy.the_world_stop.potions: Health and mana do not recover on their own - only instant potions restore them
spell.chronomancy.borrowed_future.guide: 20 s of time ×2.5 (+0.3/lvl), then 20 s of debt. Stasis and time slows from others are twice weaker.
jei.chronomancy.spell.borrowed_future: Borrow power from your future self. Your personal time runs faster, including mining and spell cooldown recovery (except Borrowed Future's own). While hastened you are more vulnerable: damage taken rises by a tenth of the haste (at 275% - by 27.5%). When the borrowed moment ends, an equally long Temporal Debt slows your time. While the spell lasts - both the haste and the debt - a stasis from others holds you half as long and time slows affect you half as much. The debt cannot be cleansed or rewound.
spell.chronomancy.borrowed_future.ward: Stasis and time slows from others: %s
jei.chronomancy.spell.chrono_double: Conjure a copper echo that smoothly follows you and mirrors your actions. It repeats melee strikes and fires real reduced-damage arrows, Backtrack bolts and temporal needles from its own position. Its temporal needles telegraph their own preparation rune and stack onto the same target charge. Echo Time Dilation orbs create shorter-lived fields. Spells of other schools - instant ones and those with a cast time - are repeated from its own side at reduced damage; continuous spells mirror casting gestures only.
item.chronomancy.deferred_pendulum.lore: The blow is still on its way; the pendulum holds it back.
item.chronomancy.deferred_pendulum.effec:
Defers |50%| of damage for |5 s|
A |fifth| of the deferred damage never arrives
item.chronomancy.second_chance_watch.lor: Its hands remember where you were still alive.
item.chronomancy.second_chance_watch.eff: Once per |3 min|, undoes a fatal blow by rewinding you |5 s|
item.chronomancy.ring_of_rifts.lore: Deep in the blue crystal, a rift is still open.
jei.chronomancy.ring_of_rifts: A blue Chronomaly shard is set in the band: its wearer's hits pass through invulnerability frames. They say the old master of the clock tower wears such a ring: once in a while he puts one up for sale, but he never parts with his own willingly. The ring no longer opens rifts - for that it is forged with pyrium into a Rift Heart.
item.chronomancy.rift_heart.lore: It beats even while time stands still.
item.chronomancy.rift_heart.effect: The World Stop opens |rifts| — only with it
jei.chronomancy.rift_heart: The crystal of a Ring of Rifts, caged in pyrium. While the Heart is worn, every World Stop opens rifts: time will not move on until you clear every wave and defeat the one who comes after them. Without the Heart no rifts open at all.
jei.chronomancy.grain_of_time.clocksmith: • An old master lives in the clock towers. He values Grains of Time above emeralds.
item.chronomancy.timeless_seal.lore: A seal that time itself walks around.
item.chronomancy.timeless_seal.effect:
Time magic against you is |halved|
No protection from |The World Stop|
item.chronomancy.cracked_dial.lore: A crack where other people's seconds get stuck.
item.chronomancy.cracked_dial.effect: Melee hits: |10%| chance of Stasis for |2 s|
item.chronomancy.hourglass_of_focus.lore: The sand runs only for those who can wait.
item.chronomancy.hourglass_of_focus.effe: |5 s| at rest, unharmed and idle, restores |all| mana
item.chronomancy.temporal_anchor.lore: The sun will not move while the anchor is down.
item.chronomancy.temporal_anchor.effect: While worn, day and night |stand still| in this dimension
item.chronomancy.clockwork_key.lore: Winds anything with gears — and a few things without.
item.chronomancy.clockwork_key.effect:
Machines within |4| blocks run |100%| faster
|+1%| per |1%| spell power, up to |9×|
item.chronomancy.clocksmith_helmet.lore: Lenses that see one second ahead.
item.chronomancy.clocksmith_chestplate.l: Beneath the brass, something ticks that is not a heart.
item.chronomancy.clock_hand.lore: The hand of a tower clock. It always had a point.
item.chronomancy.clock_hand.effect:
|Triple| damage to targets in Stasis or stopped time
|Double| damage to slowed targets, plus |+1%| per 1% of slow
item.chronomancy.chronomaly_shard.lore: A splinter of time torn loose.
message.chronomancy.time_rift.opened: Time tears open! Time will not resume until you clear every wave.
message.chronomancy.time_rift.cleared: All waves cleared (%s enemies defeated) — the rifts collapse and time flows again.
message.chronomancy.time_rift.timeout: The rifts lose their grip on time and collapse.
message.chronomancy.time_rift.failed: The trial is failed - the rifts collapse.
message.chronomancy.time_rift.island: An island of time has opened nearby: health and mana flow there again
item.chronomancy.rift_creator.lore:
A blade forged from a tear in time.
Legendary trophy of the Rift Maker.
item.chronomancy.rift_creator.effect: Rift: a copper copy of the target fights it for |10 s|
spell.chronomancy.rift.guide: Copy of a target within 32 blocks, 10 s (+1 s per 10% power).
jei.chronomancy.spell.rift: Requires a target within 32 blocks. A rift tears open beside it, and a second later a copper copy of the target steps out and attacks the original: a zombie fights a zombie, a skeleton shoots the skeleton, a creeper walks up to the original and explodes, passive mobs ram the original, and a player faces their own copper double wielding their weapon: it strikes up close and, once the player backs away, turns their own last spell (of any school) on them. The copy lasts 10 seconds (+1 second per 10% of chronomancy spell power) and vanishes early if the original dies; it drops no loot or experience. Bosses cannot be copied.
spell.chronomancy.rift.no_bosses: Requires a target; bosses cannot be copied
spell.chronomancy.rift.copy: Copper copy of the target attacks the original
message.chronomancy.time_rift.boss: Time itself tears open above you - the Rift Maker falls out of the rift!
message.chronomancy.time_rift.boss_defea: The Rift Maker falls — the rifts collapse and time flows again.
message.chronomancy.time_rift.wave_clear: Wave %s cleared — the rifts collapse, but time tears again…
effect.chronomancy.temporal_phase.descri: You are half outside of time: projectiles pass through you and deal no damage.
jei.chronomancy.spell.time_walk: Step forward through time in the direction you are looking: your body stretches to the new spot, leaving a frozen afterimage behind like Rewind. If you are looking at a block you land on top of it (or on the floor in front of it if there is no room above); otherwise you step to a point in the air. Walls stop you. After the step you are briefly phased - projectiles pass through you harmlessly. Common: 7 blocks and 3 seconds of phase; each rarity level adds 2 blocks and 0.5 seconds, and Chronomancy spell power increases both range and duration (up to 30 blocks and 10 seconds).
jei.chronomancy.grain_of_time.intro: A grain that slipped out of the flow of time. They say it can be found without any magic:
jei.chronomancy.grain_of_time.anvil: • Time cannot bear weight: clocks crushed by falling iron sometimes let a grain slip.
jei.chronomancy.grain_of_time.lightning: • Fire from the sky striking a dropped clock melts its works — and now and then leaves a grain behind.
jei.chronomancy.grain_of_time.archaeolog: • The sands of ancient temples and ruins keep what bygone ages lost. Do not spare the brush.
jei.chronomancy.grain_of_time.chronomaly: • Those who step out of the rifts carry time with them.
jei.chronomancy.clock: Every clock holds a speck of time. To free it, the clock must be broken — by weight or by fire from the sky.
